@@T0@@The 0.5 threshold is a convention,.zh:
@@T0@@0.5 这个阈值是一种惯例，而非定律。@@T1@@
          COCO 之所以在 0.5 到 0.95 的 IoU 阈值上以 0.05 为步长对 AP 取平均，正是因为单一阈值会像奖励像素级完美的框那样，奖励那些偷懒而略有偏差的框。请把 GT 框调整为同一目标的更紧与更松版本，观察 IoU 如何变化。
@@T0@@The 0.5 threshold is a convention,.src: The 0.5 threshold is a convention, not a law. COCO averages AP over IoU thresholds from 0.5 to 0.95 in steps of 0.05 precisely because a single threshold rewards lazy slightly-off boxes as much as pixel-perfect ones. Slide the GT box to tighter and looser versions of the same object and see how IoU changes.

The detector emits dozens of low-confide.zh: 检测器在给出优质猜测的同时，还会输出数十个低置信度的猜测。在实际生产环境中，你会选定一个分数阈值；只有越过该阈值的检测才会保留。滑动阈值，观察框的出现与消失。
The detector emits dozens of low-confide.src:
The detector emits dozens of low-confidence guesses alongside its
          good ones. In production, you pick a score threshold; only
          detections above the bar survive. Slide the threshold and watch
          boxes appear and vanish.

Precision, Recall, F1 vs your ground tru.src: Precision, Recall, F1 vs your ground truth

If you've drawn any GT boxes in Step 2,.zh: 若你在第 2 步绘制了任意 GT 框，我们会按 IoU ≥ 0.5 将它们与存留的检测相匹配（经典的 COCO 真阳性规则）。未被匹配的 GT 为假阴性；未被匹配的检测为假阳性。
If you've drawn any GT boxes in Step 2,.src:
If you've drawn any GT boxes in Step 2, we match them to the
          surviving detections by IoU ≥ 0.5 (classical COCO TP rule).
          Unmatched GTs are false negatives; unmatched detections are false
          positives.

@@T0@@Draw a few GT boxes first.@@T1@@\n.zh:
@@T0@@请先绘制几个 GT 框。@@T1@@
          没有真实标注时，精确率与召回率无从定义。围绕真实目标绘制 2–3 个 GT 框，然后滑动置信度阈值。观察 F1 曲线在模型的「自然」工作点附近达到峰值——对 SSD 而言通常在 0.3–0.5 左右。
@@T0@@Draw a few GT boxes first.@@T1@@\n.src: Draw a few GT boxes first. With no ground truth, precision and recall are undefined. Draw 2–3 GT boxes around real objects, then slide the confidence threshold. Watch the F1 curve peak near the model's "natural" operating point—typically around 0.3–0.5 for SSD.

Detectors fire on the same object many t.zh: 检测器会对同一目标多次响应。NMS 是经典的去重规则：
Detectors fire on the same object many t.src:
Detectors fire on the same object many times. NMS is the classical
          deduplication rule:

Sort detections by confidence, highest f.zh: 按置信度从高到低对检测排序。
Sort detections by confidence, highest f.src: Sort detections by confidence, highest first.

Discard every other detection whose IoU.zh: 丢弃所有与已保留检测的 IoU 超过 NMS 阈值的其他检测。
Discard every other detection whose IoU.src:
Discard every other detection whose IoU with the kept one
            exceeds the NMS threshold.

Repeat on the remaining detections..zh: 对剩余的检测重复上述过程。

COCO-SSD already applies its own NMS int.zh: COCO-SSD 内部已经应用了自己的 NMS。为了观察 NMS 的实际运作，我们以 @@T0@@maxNumBoxes: 40@@T1@@ 和内部 IoU 阈值 1.0 加载检测器——这意味着在模型层面 @@T2@@没有任何@@T3@@ 检测被抑制。随后你将在下方自行应用 NMS。
COCO-SSD already applies its own NMS int.src: COCO-SSD already applies its own NMS internally. To see NMS in action, we load the detector with maxNumBoxes: 40 and an internal IoU threshold of 1.0—meaning nothing is suppressed at the model level. You then apply NMS yourself below.

Faint = suppressed. Solid = kept..zh: 浅色 = 被抑制。实色 = 被保留。

The SSD running on this page is one poin.zh: 本页运行的 SSD 只是更大设计空间中的一个点。三大主流家族为：
The SSD running on this page is one poin.src:
The SSD running on this page is one point in a bigger design
          space. The three dominant families:

Dense grid of prior boxes at many scales.zh: 在多种尺度 / 宽高比上布置的先验框稠密网格；每个框预测类别 + 偏移量。
Dense grid of prior boxes at many scales.src: Dense grid of prior boxes at many scales / aspect ratios; each predicts class + offsets.

Needs NMS. Anchor hyperparameters are se.zh: 需要 NMS。锚框超参数较为敏感。
Needs NMS. Anchor hyperparameters are se.src: Needs NMS. Anchor hyperparameters are sensitive.

Per pixel (or cell): predict \"am I a ce.zh: 逐像素（或逐单元）：预测「我是否是中心？」+ 框的范围。
Per pixel (or cell): predict \"am I a ce.src: Per pixel (or cell): predict "am I a centre?" + box extents.

Assignment loss is trickier; still typic.zh: 匹配损失（assignment loss）更为棘手；通常仍使用 NMS。
Assignment loss is trickier; still typic.src: Assignment loss is trickier; still typically uses NMS.

Fixed set of learned queries; Hungarian.zh: 固定的可学习查询集合；与 GT 进行匈牙利匹配。
Fixed set of learned queries; Hungarian.src: Fixed set of learned queries; Hungarian matching against GT.

NMS-free. Trains slowly; originally weak.zh: 无需 NMS。训练缓慢；最初在小型目标上表现较弱。
NMS-free. Trains slowly; originally weak.src: NMS-free. Trains slowly; originally weak on small objects.

Precision–Recall curve and AP.zh: 精确率–召回率曲线与 AP

A single confidence threshold picks one.zh: 单一置信度阈值只对应精确率–召回率曲线上的一个点。基准评测需要整条曲线。若你已绘制 GT 框，我们会将阈值从 1 扫到 0，绘制精确率对召回率的曲线，并积分得到平均精度（AP）。
A single confidence threshold picks one.src:
A single confidence threshold picks one point on a precision-recall
          curve. Benchmarks want the whole curve. If you've drawn GT boxes,
          we sweep the threshold from 1 down to 0, plot precision against
          recall, and integrate to get Average Precision (AP).

Click \"Draw GT\" in Step 2 to populate.zh: 点击第 2 步中的「绘制 GT」以填充此曲线。
Click \"Draw GT\" in Step 2 to populate.src: Click "Draw GT" in Step 2 to populate this curve.

Area under the PR curve computed from yo.zh: 由你所绘 GT 框计算得到的 PR 曲线下面积。通常在你围绕视觉上清晰的目标绘制 GT 时更高，而在拥挤或被遮挡的场景中更低。
Area under the PR curve computed from yo.src:
Area under the PR curve computed from your drawn GT boxes.
            Usually improves when you draw GT around visually clear objects
            and shrinks on crowded or occluded scenes.

Four things that still get people.zh: 仍然会难住人们的四件事
Four things that still get people.src: Four things that still get people

@@T0@@\"A 99% confidence means the model.zh:
@@T0@@「99% 置信度意味着模型是对的。」@@T1@@@@T2@@
              现代检测器的校准很差。上传一张包含临界情形的照片，你会看到 SSD 在看似合理的错误框上飙升至 0.9。请使用 PR 曲线，而非原始数值。
@@T0@@\"A 99% confidence means the model.src:
"A 99% confidence means the model is right."
Modern detectors are badly calibrated. Upload a photo with a borderline case and you'll see SSD spike to 0.9 on plausibly wrong boxes. Use the PR curve, not the raw number.

@@T0@@\"NMS is just cleanup.\"@@T1@@@@T2.zh:
@@T0@@「NMS 只是清理工作。」@@T1@@@@T2@@
              在拥挤场景中，经典 NMS 会 @@T3@@删除真实的重复目标@@T4@@。试一张两只猫挨着坐的照片，观察其中一个框被抹掉。那是 Soft-NMS / DETR 的领域。
@@T0@@\"NMS is just cleanup.\"@@T1@@@@T2.src:
"NMS is just cleanup."
On crowded scenes, classic NMS deletes real duplicate objects. Try a photo with two cats sitting close and watch one box get killed. That's Soft-NMS / DETR territory.

@@T0@@\"mAP summarises everything.\"@@T1.zh:
@@T0@@「mAP 概括了一切。」@@T1@@@@T2@@
              也许你想要任意精确率下的 100% 召回率（医学扫描），或者任意召回率下的 100% 精确率（自动驾驶）。在选定模型之前，请始终绘制完整的 PR 曲线。
@@T0@@\"mAP summarises everything.\"@@T1.src:
"mAP summarises everything."
Maybe you want 100% recall at any precision (medical scan), or 100% precision at any recall (autopilot). Always plot the full PR curve before picking a model.

@@T0@@\"A bigger box is a safer box.\"@@.zh:
@@T0@@「框越大越安全。」@@T1@@@@T2@@
              严格包含真实框的预测，其 IoU = 真实/预测。巨大的「安全」框会拖垮 IoU。紧致者胜。
@@T0@@\"A bigger box is a safer box.\"@@.src:
"A bigger box is a safer box."
A prediction that strictly contains the truth has IoU = truth/pred. Huge "safety" boxes tank IoU. Tight wins.

@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n Y.zh:
@@T0@@最终总结。@@T1@@
          你刚刚在真实图像上运行了一个真实的 COCO 检测器，用手绘的真实标注度量了它的输出，并观察到精确率、召回率、NMS 与 AP 都如数学所预测的那样表现。现代检测研究的其余部分，就是用一个更好的骨干网络（ViT、ConvNeXt）、更好的匹配方式（基于集合、无锚框）以及更好的损失函数来替代 SSD——但每一个部分最终都落到同一张记分板上。
@@T0@@Final takeaway.@@T1@@\n Y.src: Final takeaway. You just ran a real COCO detector on real images, measured its output against ground truth you drew by hand, and watched precision, recall, NMS, and AP all behave as the math predicts. The rest of modern detection research is about replacing SSD with better backbones (ViT, ConvNeXt), better assignment (set-based, anchor-free), and better losses—but every piece ultimately lands on this same scoreboard.

@@T0@@Two-stage: R-CNN → Fast R-CNN → Fa.zh: @@T0@@两阶段：R-CNN → Fast R-CNN → Faster R-CNN。@@T1@@ 先提出候选区域，再进行分类与精修。准确但缓慢。
@@T0@@Two-stage: R-CNN → Fast R-CNN → Fa.src: Two-stage: R-CNN → Fast R-CNN → Faster R-CNN. First propose regions, then classify and refine. Accurate but slow.

@@T0@@One-stage with anchors: SSD, YOLO.zh: @@T0@@带锚框的单阶段：SSD、YOLO v1–v5、RetinaNet。@@T1@@ 锚框的稠密网格；对每个锚框预测（类别, 偏移量）。速度快，在消费级 GPU 上可实时运行。
@@T0@@One-stage with anchors: SSD, YOLO.src: One-stage with anchors: SSD, YOLO v1–v5, RetinaNet. Dense grid of anchor boxes; predict (class, offset) per anchor. Fast, real-time on consumer GPUs.

@@T0@@Anchor-free: FCOS, CenterNet.@@T1@.zh: @@T0@@无锚框：FCOS、CenterNet。@@T1@@ 在每个空间位置直接预测（类别, 框），无需调校锚框。更简单，精度具竞争力。
@@T0@@Anchor-free: FCOS, CenterNet.@@T1@.src: Anchor-free: FCOS, CenterNet. Predict (class, box) directly at each spatial location, no anchors to tune. Simpler, competitive accuracy.

@@T0@@Set-based: DETR (2020), Deformable.zh: @@T0@@基于集合：DETR（2020）、Deformable DETR、DINO、RT-DETR。@@T1@@ 带目标查询的 Transformer 解码器；无需 NMS —— 训练时的二分匹配确保每个目标只有唯一预测。2024 年以后精度优先检测的默认方案。
@@T0@@Set-based: DETR (2020), Deformable.src: Set-based: DETR (2020), Deformable DETR, DINO, RT-DETR. Transformer decoder with object queries; no NMS — bipartite matching during training ensures unique predictions per object. The 2024+ default for accuracy-first detection.

@@T0@@Open-vocabulary: Grounding DINO, O.zh: @@T0@@开放词汇：Grounding DINO、OWL-ViT、OmDet。@@T1@@ 检测由自由文本描述的任意类别。将视觉骨干网络与语言编码器相结合。
@@T0@@Open-vocabulary: Grounding DINO, O.src: Open-vocabulary: Grounding DINO, OWL-ViT, OmDet. Detect any class described in free text. Combines a vision backbone with a language encoder.

The assignment problem — anchors, FCOS,.zh: 匹配问题 —— 锚框、FCOS、匈牙利算法
The assignment problem — anchors, FCOS,.src: The assignment problem — anchors, FCOS, Hungarian

During training, each predicted box must.zh: 训练期间，每个预测框都必须匹配到一个真实标注框（或被标记为「背景」）。这种 @@T0@@匹配（assignment）@@T1@@ 是各检测器家族之间最大的差异。
During training, each predicted box must.src: During training, each predicted box must be matched to a ground-truth box (or labelled "background"). This assignment is the largest difference between detector families.

@@T0@@Anchor-based.@@T1@@ A predicted bo.zh: @@T0@@基于锚框。@@T1@@ 若 $\mathrm{IoU}(a, g) > \tau$（典型值 $\tau = 0.5$），则位于锚框 $a$ 处的预测框与 GT $g$ 匹配。简单，但锚框尺度/比例的选择是一个超参数。
@@T0@@Anchor-based.@@T1@@ A predicted bo.src: Anchor-based. A predicted box at anchor $a$ matches GT $g$ if $\mathrm{IoU}(a, g) > \tau$ (typical $\tau = 0.5$). Simple, but the choice of anchor scales/ratios is a hyperparameter.

@@T0@@Centre-based (FCOS).@@T1@@ A spati.zh: @@T0@@基于中心（FCOS）。@@T1@@ 若某空间位置位于 $g$ 内部，且处在以其中心为基准的、随尺度变化的带状区域内，则该位置与 GT $g$ 匹配。无需锚框。
@@T0@@Centre-based (FCOS).@@T1@@ A spati.src: Centre-based (FCOS). A spatial location matches GT $g$ if it's inside $g$ and within a per-scale band of its centre. No anchors.

@@T0@@Hungarian / bipartite (DETR).@@T1@.zh: @@T0@@匈牙利 / 二分匹配（DETR）。@@T1@@ 求解一个分配问题，使每个 GT 恰好匹配 @@T2@@一个@@T3@@ 预测，并最小化一个（代价 + IoU + 类别）损失。没有重复预测就意味着无需 NMS 后处理。
@@T0@@Hungarian / bipartite (DETR).@@T1@.src: Hungarian / bipartite (DETR). Solve an assignment problem so each GT matches exactly one prediction, minimising a (cost + IoU + class) loss. No duplicates means no NMS post-processing.

Set-based DETR-style assignment was the.zh: 基于集合的 DETR 式匹配是一项突破，它最终使 Transformer 检测器能够与单阶段 CNN 相抗衡。一旦移除了人工设计的匹配规则，扩大骨干网络的规模就能带来干净的性能提升。
Set-based DETR-style assignment was the.src: Set-based DETR-style assignment was the breakthrough that finally made transformer detectors competitive with one-stage CNNs. Once you remove the assignment hand-crafting, scaling backbones gives clean gains.

@@T0@@Girshick (2014–15)@@T1@@ — R-CNN,.zh: @@T0@@Girshick（2014–15）@@T1@@ —— R-CNN、Fast R-CNN。两阶段方法的基石。
@@T0@@Girshick (2014–15)@@T1@@ — R-CNN,.src: Girshick (2014–15) — R-CNN, Fast R-CNN. The two-stage foundations.

@@T0@@Carion et&nbsp;al. (2020)@@T1@@ —.zh: @@T0@@Carion 等（2020）@@T1@@ —— @@T2@@DETR。@@T3@@ 基于 Transformer 的集合预测器。

meta.title: 基于真实检测器的目标检测
meta.tagline: 上传任意照片，实时运行真实的 COCO-SSD 模型，并审视其每一个决策
meta.summary: 一个预训练的 COCO-SSD 模型可在你的浏览器中加载并运行于你提供的任意照片。拖出真实标注框以与其预测相比较，扫描置信度阈值，运行 NMS，并绘制精确率–召回率曲线 —— 全部基于真实的检测器输出。
highlights: 通过 TensorFlow.js 在浏览器内加载真正预训练的 SSD-MobileNetV2（COCO）模型 —— 真实的检测结果、真实的置信度。
上传任意照片、尝试摄像头帧，或从六张图库样例中挑选一张；所有下游数值均实时更新。
绘制你自己的真实标注框；交并比、精确率、召回率、F1、NMS 与 AP 均针对真实模型输出计算。
滑动置信度与 NMS-IoU 阈值，观察精确率–召回率曲线重新绘制。
